desc_en: Orion, a Striker (ST) who tears through tight spaces with lightning-fast bursts and delivers a finishing strike in the blink of an eye.
desc_zh: 球员Orion，ST，以迅雷般的短距突破撕裂封锁，于电光火石之间轰出致命一击。

passives.desc_en: Increases low shot speed by 20%
passives.desc_zh: 低射时射门球速提升20%

passives.desc_en: Grants 2s of knockdown and interruption immunity when receiving the ball inside the opponent's box
passives.desc_zh: 停球时，如若在敌方禁区内，获得2秒的霸体

passives.desc_en: When the player's team scores a goal, the entire team gains 15 Ultimate Energy
passives.desc_zh: 我方进球后，我方全队增加15点大招能量

passives.desc_en: Always performs a Rabona shot when shooting while in possession near the opponent's box
passives.desc_zh: 禁区附近带球射门时，必定使用插花脚射门

desc_en: Hayato, a Central Midfielder (CM) who breaks past defenders with phantom-like footwork, stringing together quick bursts that no back line can contain.
desc_zh: 球员Hayato，CM，双足如幻影起舞，任何防线都无法束缚他连续突破的步伐。

passives.desc_en: Reduces the chance of being dispossessed while using Skill Moves
passives.desc_zh: 使用花式动作时不容易被断球

passives.desc_en: Increases ball speed by 10% when tapping a teammate to pass
passives.desc_zh: 点击队员传球时，球速提高10%

passives.desc_en: For each goal the team is trailing by, the entire team gains 1 Ball Control and Shooting
passives.desc_zh: 比分每落后一分，全队控球和射门属性加1点

passives.desc_en: Increases Balance by 6. Enables immediate passing while performing Skill Moves or using an Ultimate.
passives.desc_zh: 平衡+6，使用花式动作或者大招时，可以立刻传球

passives.desc_en: Automatically turns the body toward the ball when performing a Sliding Tackle
passives.desc_zh: 滑铲时，身体会自动转向球的方向

passives.desc_en: Reduces Stamina consumption by 30% while in own half
passives.desc_zh: 在本方半场时，体力消耗降低30%

passives.desc_en: When a Sliding Tackle connects with no other opponents within 3m, there is a 60% chance to keep the ball at the player's feet
passives.desc_zh: 滑铲命中时，周围3米内没有其他敌方单位，有60%几率将球留在脚下

passives.desc_en: Reduces nearby opponents' movement speed by 15% and Shooting by 10
passives.desc_zh: 降低附近对手15%的移动速度和10点射门属性

passives.desc_en: Increases movement speed by 12% for 1.5s after knocking the ball forward
passives.desc_zh: 趟球后移动速度提升12%，持续1.5秒

passives.desc_en: Instantly recovers 300 Stamina when dispossessed by a tackle
passives.desc_zh: 被抢断/铲断时，立刻恢复300点体力

passives.desc_en: Has a 50% chance to resist being knocked down when tackled
passives.desc_zh: 被铲断时，有50%概率不摔倒

passives.desc_en: Using an Ultimate increases all attributes by 9 for 30s
passives.desc_zh: 释放大招后，获得9点全属性增加，持续30秒

passives.desc_en: Grants 2s of knockdown and interruption immunity when receiving the ball inside the opponent's box
passives.desc_zh: 停球时，如若在敌方禁区内，获得2秒的霸体

passives.desc_en: After the player's shot is saved by the goalkeeper, the player's next shot gains 30 Shot Power
passives.desc_zh: 被守门员扑救后，下一次射门，射门力量加30

passives.desc_en: Increases Shot Power by 15. This effect is shared with the teammate participating in Dual Impact.
passives.desc_zh: 自身射门力量+15，与自己配合释放双龙出海的球员共享这个效果

passives.desc_en: When the player's team scores a goal, the entire team gains 15 Ultimate Energy
passives.desc_zh: 我方进球后，我方全队增加15点大招能量

desc_en: Rafael, a Striker (ST) who lives for the goal and uses feints and fake shots to deliver the decisive finish for his team.
desc_zh: 球员Rafael，ST，将球门位置刻入基因，在虚晃假射中为球队一锤定音。

passives.desc_en: Shooting immediately after Skill Moves increases ball speed by 8%
passives.desc_zh: 花式后立刻射门，球速增加8%

passives.desc_en: Increases shot speed by 10% and reduces ball drop during flight by 10%
passives.desc_zh: 射门球速提升10%，球在飞行过程中下坠幅度减少10%

passives.desc_en: Activating Dash grants an additional 10% speed boost and has a 20% chance not to consume a Dash charge
passives.desc_zh: 开启主动加速时，获得额外的10%速度加成，并有20%概率不消耗加速点数

passives.desc_en: Reduces the chance of being dispossessed while using Skill Moves
passives.desc_zh: 使用花式动作时不容易被断球

desc_en: Moco, a Central Midfielder (CM) who dictates the attacking tempo with deft short passes, pulls defenses apart through fluid passing and movement, and links the entire team into a rapid attacking force.
desc_zh: 球员Moco，CM，以灵动短传牵引锋线节奏，于传跑交错之间撕开防线，并将全队串联成疾速推进的利刃。

passives.desc_en: Passes to a locked-on teammate cannot be blocked for the first 0.3s
passives.desc_zh: 使用锁定队友传球时，前0.3秒无法被阻挡

passives.desc_en: Increases ball speed by 10% when tapping a teammate to pass
passives.desc_zh: 点击队员传球时，球速提高10%

passives.desc_en: After passing to a teammate, their Shooting increases by 8 for 3s after receiving the ball
passives.desc_zh: 传球给友军，友军拿到球后射门属性增加8点，持续3秒

passives.desc_en: Grants more rear vision while dribbling
passives.desc_zh: 盘带时，能获得更多的后方视野

passives.desc_en: Automatically turns the body toward the ball when performing a Standing Tackle
passives.desc_zh: 抢断时，身体会自动转向球的方向

passives.desc_en: Automatically marks opponents in front while in defensive stance
passives.desc_zh: 使用防守姿态时，会自动跟防身前的单位

passives.desc_en: Increases Blocking by 6. Increases movement speed by 15% while in defensive stance.
passives.desc_zh: 封堵属性+6，防守姿态下的移动速度增加15%

passives.desc_en: Recovers 350 Stamina after a successful tackle
passives.desc_zh: 抢断/滑铲成功后，恢复350点体力

desc_en: Homer, a Central Midfielder (CM) who sees the whole pitch with exceptional vision and controls the middle and attacking third with pinpoint crosses.
desc_zh: 球员Homer，CM，超级视野精准制导，以精妙传中控制整个中前场。

passives.desc_en: After passing to a teammate, their Shooting increases by 8 for 3s after receiving the ball
passives.desc_zh: 传球给友军，友军拿到球后射门属性增加8点，持续3秒

passives.desc_en: When using Lob Pass, ball speed increases by 5% and drop speed increases by 20%
passives.desc_zh: 使用挑传时，球速增加5%，下坠速度提高20%

passives.desc_en: Each pass or shot during Full Vision increases its duration by 4s
passives.desc_zh: 再全域视野效果下，每进行一次传球/射门，增加4秒全域视野的时长

passives.desc_en: Grants more rear vision while dribbling
passives.desc_zh: 盘带时，能获得更多的后方视野

desc_en: Oscar, a Striker (ST) who charges forward like a beast unleashed, barrels through defenders with unstoppable force, sends opponents flying, and finishes with a thunderous strike.
desc_zh: 球员Oscar，ST，蓄势如猛兽出笼，以无可阻挡的冲锋碾碎拦截，奔袭之中撞飞敌手并轰出震撼一击。

passives.desc_en: Increases Ball-Winning by 6 inside either team's box
passives.desc_zh: 在敌我方禁区内，争抢值增加6点

passives.desc_en: Shots from tight angles travel 10% faster and drop more quickly
passives.desc_zh: 在小角度区域射门时，球速获得提升10%，并且球下坠更快

passives.desc_en: Increases low shot speed by 20%
passives.desc_zh: 低射时射门球速提升20%

passives.desc_en: Increases Shot Power by 10 for 3s after using Dash
passives.desc_zh: 使用加速后3s内，射门力量+10

desc_en: Steffie, a Center Back (CB) who sweeps away threats with swift, precise consecutive Sliding Tackles, anchors the back line, and turns the entire team into an ironclad counterattacking force.
desc_zh: 球员Steffie，CB，以迅捷而精准的连续滑铲扫清威胁，既能守住后场阵地，也能令全队化作高速反击的钢铁锋线。

passives.desc_en: Using Dash has a 50% chance to reduce its cooldown by 3s
passives.desc_zh: 每次使用加速技能时，有50%概率使其冷却时间减少3秒

passives.desc_en: The closer the player is to the ball during Ball-Winning, the greater the chance of winning possession
passives.desc_zh: 争抢时，如果离球的位置越近，则越容易抢到球

passives.desc_en: A teammate gains 10% movement speed for 3s after receiving the player's pass
passives.desc_zh: 传球给友军，友军拿到球后速度增加10%，持续3秒

passives.desc_en: Reduces Stamina consumption by 30% while in own half
passives.desc_zh: 在本方半场时，体力消耗降低30%

desc_en: Tatsuya, a Wing Forward (WF) who slips into gaps like a shadow, wins possession with high-speed Dashes, and tears through the opposing defense with rapid changes of direction.
desc_zh: 球员Tatsuya，WF，瞬身如影般突入空隙，以高速冲锋夺取球权，并在连续折向之间撕裂敌阵防守。

passives.desc_en: Activating Dash grants an additional 10% speed boost and has a 20% chance not to consume a Dash charge
passives.desc_zh: 开启主动加速时，获得额外的10%速度加成，并有20%概率不消耗加速点数

passives.desc_en: Has a 50% chance to resist being knocked down when tackled
passives.desc_zh: 被铲断时，有50%概率不摔倒

passives.desc_en: When the player's team is tied or leading, Stamina Recovery increases by 8. Otherwise, Shot Accuracy increases by 8.
passives.desc_zh:
己方进球数≥对方进球数时，自身耐力恢复速度+8
反之，自身射门精度+8

passives.desc_en: After the player passes or shoots, teammates' off-ball response range increases by 15%
passives.desc_zh: 自身进行传球/射门时，队友无球动作的响应范围增加15%
